title: Ikatan sing Ditulis Ulang dening Wahyu
intro: Bayangna awakmu dhewe dipercaya karo wong sing penting banget, banjur ngadhepi prentah sing ngakhiri ikatan kasebut demi ketaatan. Wahyu mbentuk maneh sak kluwarga, lan jeneng sing dadi pusat prentah kasebut dudu jeneng sing dituju.
clues: Aku ngadeg ing ngendi kasetyan pribadi kudu pasrah marang ketaatan ilahi.
Aku dikenal ing kulawargané Utusan minangka anak angkat.
Aku ngerti nèk pernikahanku dadi inti saka wahyu sing ditujokaké marang Rasulullah.
Aku krungu tembung, 'Jaga bojomu lan wedia marang Allah,' ditujokake marang aku.
Aku banjur ngerti yen Allah ndhawuhi Rasulullah supaya megat sawetara bojo, lan perkawinanku dhewe kudu dipungkasi miturut prentah kasebut.
Aku Zaid bin Harithah, anak angkat sing dijenengi ing Surah Al-Ahzb.

trial.label: Uji Coba/Acara
options: Dikon njaga bojone banjur dikon megat bojone
Turu ing njero guwa nganti pirang-pirang abad
trial.answer: Dikon njaga bojone banjur dikon megat bojone

Diwenehi kekuasaan ing Timur lan Kulon
outcome.answer: Manut karo prentahe, pegatan karo bojone, lan perkawinane bubar

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
